name: Cholamandalam Investment & Finance Company Ltd
about: Cholamandalam Investment & Finance Company is one of the premier diversified non-banking finance companies in India, engaged in providing vehicle finance, home loans and Loan against property.[1]
keyPoints:
Promoter
The company is part of the Murugappa Group, a prominent Chennai-based conglomerate founded in 1900. With a $9.3 billion portfolio, the group spans three sectors with 29 businesses and nine listed companies. It operates 113 manufacturing sites in 50 countries and employs over 83,000 people. [1] [2]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 32.2% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's median sales growth is 18.4% of last 10 years
cons: Stock is trading at 5.41 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
